title: Mailchimp Marketing API key: one-property twin (length) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 30-byte hex body vs the 32 of Mailchimp's own plugin example and every tool (no source reports 30); suffix unchanged, length: 33-byte hex body (one extra at offset 16) vs the 32 of Mailchimp's own plugin example and every tool; suffix unchanged, and length: 40-byte hex body (a SHA-1 width: 8 extra hex bytes appended) vs the 32 of Mailchimp's own plugin example and every tool (no source reports 40); suffix unchanged. Twin of "Mailchimp Marketing API key: must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
